title: Funthree
summary: A synthetic health-data generation subproject (synthetic-health-sdg) that trains and compares generative models on tabular health datasets. It uses SDV's TVAESynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to fit, sample, and evaluate synthetic data quality via evaluate_quality.
needs: No README found for repo; overall project purpose ('Funthree'/promptcraft) unclear beyond the IEEE/synthetic-health-sdg subfolder, which appears to be the sole SDV-related content.
